reviews.text: After our dog died, we thought a painting would best keep her memory alive. We’re so glad we hired Anna. Anna’s work is amazing and she captured all the details only we would recognize. We will cherish this painting forever!

Anna is an excellent artist!  My dad commissioned a painting of my dog, Elliot, and I burst into happy tears as soon as I saw it.  The painting perfectly encapsulated Elliot's mischievously cute personality. I highly recommend Anna!

Anna's awesome!!  I commissioned a picture of my daughter's dog Elliott as a surprise gift. Anna was fun to work with and professional throughout the process - selecting the pictures, asking about Elliott's personality,  answering questions about framing, packaging, etc.  Loved the portrait and my daughter was in tears when she opened it.

my sister and her husband got a puppy about 15 years ago, a great way to prep for future kids, a few months later they found out she was pregnant! baby Jack and Kieron grew up together and he was an amazing family dog. Kieron  passed away a few years ago leaving quite a void. When my Anna Hileman said she does Pet portraits I knew I needed to commission one of Kieron for My sister!

She captured his eyes and his spirit so well! And her style was perfect for them, she knew what they wanted better than I could have even known! and she is so professional, project took a few weeks, price was more than reasonable and after she showed it to me she wrapped it up so nicely!

Thank you Anna!

same photo different lighting, doesn’t even do it justice

I am lucky to have several pieces of Anna's art. I am constantly getting compliments on her art in my home and look forward to the next piece. I highly recommend Anna for a pet portrait as she possesses a unique ability to bring out the character and personality of a pet through her paintings. If I could give her a million stars, I would! Thank you Anna!
